# frasam

Fisheries Research Agency (FRA) develops a State-space Assessment Model
(SAM)

日本の水産資源用に開発された状態空間資源評価モデルです

# Package index

## All functions

- [`Calcu_Bmsy()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Calcu_Bmsy.md)
  : Calculate the stock biomass at the maximum sustainable yield (Bmsy).
- [`Calcu_F0.1()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Calcu_F0.1.md)
  : Calculate F0.1 value.
- [`Calcu_Fmax()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Calcu_Fmax.md)
  : Calculate the fishing mortality that maximizes the yield per
  recruit.
- [`Calcu_Fmsy()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Calcu_Fmsy.md)
  : Calculate the fishing mortality that maximizes the maximum
  sustainable yield (Fmsy) with fixed steepness parameters (h) in the
  Bevertoh-Holt stock-recruitment relationship.
- [`Calcu_N()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Calcu_N.md)
  : Calculate the relative number at age at the equilibrium.
- [`Calcu_SBR()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Calcu_SBR.md)
  : Calculate spawning biomass per recruit (SBR) with a given fishing
  mortality value.
- [`Calcu_SBmsy()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Calcu_SBmsy.md)
  : Calculate the spawning stock biomass at the maximum sustainable
  yield (SSBmsy).
- [`Calcu_SPR_X()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Calcu_SPR_X.md)
  : Calculate F%SPR: the fishing mortality that reduces the spawning
  biomass per recruit (SBR) to X % of those without fishing (SPR0).
- [`Calcu_YPR()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Calcu_YPR.md)
  : Calculate yield per recruit with a given fishing mortality value.
- [`Est_SR()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/Est_SR.md)
  : Estimate the Beverton-Holt and hockey-stick stock recruitment
  relationships from data of spawning stock biomass (SBy) and recruits
  (Ry) with a give steepness (h) value.
- [`caa_plot()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/caa_plot.md)
  : Catch at ageの当てはまりについてプロットする関数
- [`calc_mase()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/calc_mase.md)
  : レトロの結果から各Indexに対する予測値を抽出して、Mean Absolute
  Scaled Errorを計算する関数
- [`calc_metrics()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/calc_metrics.md)
  : Calculate regression/forecast accuracy and bias metrics
- [`check_fit_sam()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/check_fit_sam.md)
  : Check convergence diagnostics for a SAM fit
- [`convert_sam_tibble()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/convert_sam_tibble.md)
  : SAMの結果オブジェクトをtibble形式に変換する関数
- [`divide_sigma()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/divide_sigma.md)
  : 観測誤差とプロセス誤差をどこかの年齢間で分けて推定し直す関数
- [`do_jitter()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/do_jitter.md)
  : Do jitter analysis
- [`do_loo_index()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/do_loo_index.md)
  : Do leave-one-out index analysis
- [`do_osa_resid()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/do_osa_resid.md)
  : SAMのOSA residualを計算する関数
- [`est_fixed()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/est_fixed.md)
  : SAMの固定効果だけを推定する関数
- [`est_mixed()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/est_mixed.md)
  : TMB::MakeADFunに必要な引数から固定効果とランダム効果を推定する関数
- [`fit2PSdata()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/fit2PSdata.md)
  : 生成された疑似データにVPA/SAMを推定し、Self-test/Cross-testを実行
- [`get_pm()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/get_pm.md)
  : utilities for extracting statistics
- [`get_predSR()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/get_predSR.md)
  : SAMで推定された再生産関係の予測値
- [`index_plot()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/index_plot.md)
  : Indexの当てはまりについてプロットする関数
- [`index_plot2()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/index_plot2.md)
  : Indexの当てはまりについてプロットする関数
- [`make_assess_result()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/make_assess_result.md)
  :
  SAMの結果を読み込んで主要なパラメータの予測値とSD、信頼区間などを出力する
- [`make_named_list()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/make_named_list.md)
  : Making a combined list with original list name(s)
- [`out_par()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/out_par.md)
  : SAMのFixed effect parametersの表を出力する
- [`out_sam()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/out_sam.md)
  : output sam object results
- [`plot_SR_simple()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/plot_SR_simple.md)
  : 再生産関係についてプロットする関数
- [`plot_boosam()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/plot_boosam.md)
  : ブートストラップについてプロットする関数
- [`plot_hindcastCV()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/plot_hindcastCV.md)
  : レトロの結果を使って資源量指標値に対するhindcast cross
  validationをプロットする関数
- [`plot_osa_resid()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/plot_osa_resid.md)
  : OSA residualをプロットする関数
- [`plot_popsim()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/plot_popsim.md)
  : Popsimの結果ををプロットする関数
- [`plot_samvpa()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/plot_samvpa.md)
  : Plot SAM or VPA results
- [`popsim_vpasam()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/popsim_vpasam.md)
  : Popsimと同じ手法でSAMとVPAの疑似データを生成する
- [`retro_plot()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/retro_plot.md)
  : レトロスペクティブ解析の結果をプロットする
- [`retro_sam()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/retro_sam.md)
  : レトロスペクティブ解析を実施する
- [`rmvnorm_prec()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/rmvnorm_prec.md)
  : Simulate multivariate normal variables given a mean vector and
  precision matrix
- [`safe_do_call()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/safe_do_call.md)
  :
  do.callの引数が与えられていない場合にディフォルト値を与えて計算する関数
- [`sam()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/sam.md) :
  SAMによる資源計算を実施する
- [`samprofile()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/samprofile.md)
  : SAMで推定されたパラメータに対してプロファイル尤度を計算する
- [`select_sigma()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/select_sigma.md)
  :
  観測誤差やプロセス誤差のステップ形式のモデル選択（一つの変数について）
- [`select_sigma_grid()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/select_sigma_grid.md)
  :
  観測誤差やプロセス誤差のステップ形式のモデル選択（複数の変数について）
- [`shift_SRdata_rec_age()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/shift_SRdata_rec_age.md)
  : rec.age\>0のときにRをずらす関数
- [`sumup_popsim()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/sumup_popsim.md)
  : Self-test, Cross-testの結果をまとめるための関数
- [`update_sam()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/update_sam.md)
  : Update SAM result by new parameters of fixed and random effects
- [`use_sam_tmb()`](https://shotanishijima.github.io/frasam/reference/use_sam_tmb.md)
  : SAMでTMBで実行するためにcppファイルのコンパイル等をする関数
